data.name: Kumaresh
data.gender_notes: Kumaresh is used as a male name in Hindu naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: Ku means 'Lord' or 'God' in Sanskrit, Ma means 'Mother' or 'Goddess', and Rish means 'Ascetic' or 'Sage'. Kumaresh is a name of Lord Shiva, signifying the god who is the ruler of the universe and the protector of his devotees. The name Kumaresh carries the meaning “Lord of the Universe” and is chosen by families in Hindu traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Sanskrit tradition and is also used in Hindi, Sanskrit, Marathi. Parents who choose Kumaresh usually hope their child will grow to embody lord of the universe and live with faith, good character and purpose.
data.spiritual_meaning: Emblematic of divine power, protection, and wisdom.
data.etymology: Kumaresh belongs to the Sanskrit linguistic tradition and is used in Hindu naming. Its recorded meaning is “Lord of the Universe.”
data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Kumaresh total 6, giving a life-path number of 6. Number 6 is linked with Venus and with the qualities of responsibility, care and community.

data.cultural_impact: The name 'Kumaresh' holds great cultural significance in Hinduism as it is a name of one of the most revered deities - Lord Shiva. Lord Shiva is considered to be the supreme god, the destroyer of negative energies, and the giver of prosperity and blessing to his devotees. The name Kumaresh is also a popular one in the southern parts of India, particularly in Tamil Nadu, and is often used in Hindu temples and religious rituals.
data.spiritual_significance: The spiritual significance of the name 'Kumaresh' lies in its representation of Lord Shiva as the ultimate protector and caretaker of his followers. The name 'Kumaresh' symbolizes the god within us, who is always there to guide and protect us from harm. It is a reminder of the divine power present within us, which can help us overcome any challenges and obstacles in life. The name Kumaresh also represents the ascetic and sage-like qualities of Lord Shiva, who renounced worldly pleasures to attain self-realization and enlightenment. By invoking the name Kumaresh, we seek his blessings and seek to emulate his divine qualities within ourselves.
data.spiritual_symbolism: Kumaresh symbolizes the embodiment of Lord Shiva's divine and youthful energies. The name 'Kumaresh' signifies being under the protective and nurturing grace of Lord Shiva, the God of destruction and creation. It inspires one to live a virtuous life, filled with courage and devotion.

historical_references.reference: Kumaresh is a name mentioned in the ancient Tamil epic Silappathikaram, believed to have been written between the 3rd and 5th centuries CE.

trends: used as a given name in India
modern_usage.modern_context: Kumaresh is a common name in India, particularly in the Tamil-speaking regions. It is derived from the Tamil word 'kumar' meaning 'boy' or 'youth', and the suffix 'es' which denotes respect or reverence. In modern usage, the name is often given to boys and is used as a title of respect for men.
